research_scope: Correct proven errors found while re-verifying Skill Research Batch 17 against current Xenoverse 2-specific skill references. Historical Batch 17 remains unchanged for auditability; these corrections supersede its incorrect canonical fields.

verification_audit.method: Compared each Batch 17 record with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill pages and character data. Corrections are limited to fields directly contradicted by current references; unsupported probabilities remain unresolved.

corrections.name: Heat Dome Attack
corrections.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 40 — The Future Warriors!; skill reward
corrections.skill_description: Trunks raises his hands and creates a large Ki dome before firing a huge Ki wave upward.
corrections.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 data lists 300 Ki, a 23-hit vertical dome attack, and approximately 40% documented damage. The current acquisition source is PQ40, replacing the incorrect PQ26 attribution from Batch 17.

correction_of.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 26 — Warrior's Annihilation - Future Chapters; Ultimate Finish reward

corrections.name: Freedom Kick

corrections.skill_description: Fly around the opponent and launch a four-hit Strike attack that tracks a knocked-away target.
corrections.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 data lists Freedom Kick as a 100-Ki, four-hit Strike Super. The current acquisition source is PQ29, replacing the incorrect PQ27 attribution from Batch 17.

correction_of.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 27 — Artificial Warriors; reward for defeating Android 17

corrections.name: Rolling Bullet
corrections.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 42 — Artificial Warriors; skill reward
corrections.skill_description: Scatter Ki Blasts around the user while ascending as an evasive action.
corrections.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 data classifies Rolling Bullet as a Ki Blast Evasive, not a Strike Super. It costs 200 stamina and is associated with PQ42. This replaces Batch 17's incorrect Super/Strike classification, Ki cost, and PQ27 acquisition.

correction_of.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 27 — Artificial Warriors; reward for defeating Android 18

corrections.name: Super Drain

corrections.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 data lists Super Drain as a 100-Ki Strike Super that drains two stamina bars and restores up to two bars to the user. This replaces Batch 17's incorrect PQ28/Ultimate-Finish attribution and incorrect three-bar transfer claim.

correction_of.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 28 — Take Back the Dragon Balls!; Ultimate Finish reward after defeating Cell
